entry.title: Validation in EDI processing in SAP GUI
entry.content: We have a requirement to validate the price received through EDI while creating the Sales Order in SAP. The expected process should be as follows: When a Sales Order is received through EDI, the price provided in the EDI message should be checked against the price maintained in the Customer Condition Record. . If the EDI price matches the Customer Record price, the Sales Order should be created successfully. If the EDI price does not match the Customer Record price, the Sales Order should not be created. In case of a price mismatch, an appropriate error message should be generated and the EDI/IDoc should be processed with an error status.

entry.title: SAP TM 9.6 SP11 – Standard API/BAPI/FM to Create Rate Values and New Validity Periods Programmatical
entry.content:
Hello SAP Community,

I am working on a custom ABAP report in SAP Transportation Management (SAP TM 9.6 SP11) to automate the upload of linehaul rates from an Excel file provided by carriers.

The requirement is to update existing rate tables by creating new validity periods and adding the corresponding rate values.

The expected functionality includes:

  1. Identifying the existing active validity period for a rate table.

  2. Updating the existing Valid To date to one day before the new Valid From date.

  3. Creating a new validity period with the required Valid From and Valid To dates.

  4. Adding the required calculation rule and rate values.

  5. Saving and releasing the rate table.

  6. Implementing error handling and delta-run functionality to reprocess failed records.

I have investigated the standard report /SCMTMS/TCC_RATES_EXCEL_NEW and the function module /SCMTMS/WRITE_RATE_RFC, but I have not yet identified a suitable, supported API for implementing the complete requirement directly from my custom report.

I would appreciate guidance on the following questions:

  • Is there a standard BAPI, function module, or class available in SAP TM 9.6 SP11 to create or update rate values and validity periods programmatically?

  • Can the /scmtms/tc_rates BOPF business object be used for this requirement? If so, which nodes, actions, or APIs should be investigated?

  • Is there a supported way to reuse the standard Excel upload processing without manually reproducing its logic?

  • Can /SCMTMS/RATE_MASS_UPDATE handle this scenario, or is it intended for a different use case?

  • Are there any relevant SAP Notes, documentation, or working implementation examples available?

My preference is to use standard SAP functionality wherever possible rather than directly updating database tables or implementing unsupported persistence logic.

Any technical guidance or examples specific to SAP TM 9.6 would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you.

entry.title: Exit to Create a Debit/Credit Memo in VA01 with reference to a BIlling Document
entry.content:
Hello Experts,

When creating a debit/credit memo in transaction VA01 with reference to a billing document, the system automatically copies the items, materials, and properties, and correctly updates the document flow (showing the preceding billing document, goods receipt, etc.) when viewed in VA03.

I am currently facing a requirement where I need to create a debit/credit memo via VA01 **without** using the standard reference to a billing document (i.e., created in "normal" mode), but I still need the document flow to link back to that specific billing document.

To achieve this, I attempted to use the user exit `USEREXIT_SAVE_DOCUMENT_PREPARE` by populating the following internal structures:

- **XVBFA (Document Flow):**
- VBELV: Billing document number (preceding document)
- POSNV: Billing document item
- VBELN: Left empty (assigned by the system upon saving)
- POSNN: Debit/credit memo item
- VBTYP_V: 'M' (Invoice)
- VBTYP_N: 'H' (Returns / Credit Memo depending on config)
- RFMNG, MEINS, RFWRT, WAERS, ERDAT, ERZET
- UPDKZ: 'I' (Insert)

- **XVBAK (Header):**
- VGBEL: Reference billing document number
- VGTYP: 'M' (Invoice)

- **XVBAP (Items):**
- VGPOS: Reference billing document item
- UPDKZ: 'U' (Update)

But when I check the document flow in VA03 after saving, the reference to the billing document does not appear; I only see the debit/credit memo itself.

Has anyone faced a similar requirement? Is there an alternative user exit, BAdI, or specific field combination required to force the document flow and reference fields to persist when creating a document without direct reference?

entry.title: Reading classic dynpro flow logic remotely over ADT (HTTP): is there an endpoint, or only RFC?
entry.content:
Hi all,

This morning I was answering a question about the partner tab in VA01 (function group V09C, screen 1000), and I wanted to read the flow logic of that screen to see which modules run inside LOOP WITH CONTROL. I read most standard code through ADT, and for classes, function modules and includes everything is there. For classic screens I got stuck.

What I checked, on S/4HANA 2023 (SAP_BASIS 758) and S/4HANA 2025 (816):

  • The ADT discovery document (/sap/bc/adt/discovery) has no collection for classic screens in either release. The only "screen" in it is the value help for logical database selection screens.
  • The where-used list does know the screen: a where-used on PBO module IS_ENHANCEMENT_01 returns screen 1000 as object type FUGR/PS, with a /sap/bc/adt/vit/wb/... URI. I haven't found a source endpoint behind it.
  • Over RFC there is a way: SVRS_GET_VERSION_DYNP_40 is RFC-enabled and has a D022S_TAB table parameter, which is the flow logic. IMPORT_DYNPRO is RFC-enabled too, but it returns only the header (D020S) and the fields (D021S). RPY_DYNPRO_READ has everything, but it is not RFC-enabled.

So my question: is there an ADT (HTTP) endpoint that returns the flow logic of a classic screen, read-only, that I'm missing? Or is the honest answer "SAP GUI or RFC"?

And if you work with ADT in VS Code or in Eclipse without SAP GUI, how do you look at PBO/PAI today?

In the V09C case I got around it from the other side: SAP's own IS-Oil enhancement implementation OIG_SAPLV09C_01 works on the current table control line, so that module has to run inside the loop. But I would like to see it, not deduce it.

entry.title: Replace FIFO-assigned batches in outbound delivery (batch split items) via BAPI – VLBAPI 004 / /SPE/
entry.content:
Goal
I create an outbound delivery with BAPI_OUTB_DELIVERY_CREATE_SLS (via UiPath/NCo). Batch determination assigns batches by FIFO, which creates batch split sub-items (9000xx) under the parent items (parent LFIMG = 0, batch in the child). I then need to replace these batches with specific batches (serial numbers = CHARG) that were scanned on a check sheet. I must not post goods issue.

What works manually
In VL02N, on the item overview, I can either overwrite the batch on the batch split item, or add a new batch split item with the desired batch and delete the old one. Both save without errors.

What I tried with BAPI_OUTB_DELIVERY_CHANGE

  1. Changing BATCH on the child item (ITEM_DATA + ITEM_CONTROL😞 VLBAPI 004 – “Error in document &1 item &2 (quantity consistency check)”.
  2. Deleting the old child item and adding a new one (ITEM_DATA with HIERARITEM = parent, USEHIERITM = ‘1’, MATERIAL, BATCH, DLV_QTY; ITEM_ORG with PLANT/STGE_LOC; ITEM_CONTROL-CHG_DELQTY = ‘X’): /SPE/DIRDLV 006 when STGE_LOC is not given, and /SPE/DIRDLV 014 (“no warehouse number for 1000/IFGL”) when it is given.
  3. Add first, then delete: same errors. In one run the delete was committed before the add failed, which left a parent item with no child item.

The BAPI return table is checked, and BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK is called on error.

System info

  • QAS system, plant 1000, storage location IFGL (this storage location does not belong to a warehouse number).
  • Stock comes from MCHB (CLABS > 0), batches are managed per material.

Questions

  1. Is there a supported way to change or replace the batch of a batch split item in an existing delivery from a program (without GUI automation)? For example WS_DELIVERY_UPDATE_2 with VBPOK_TAB / VBKOK_WA, or BAPI_OUTB_DELIVERY_CHANGE with specific fields that I missed?
  2. Why do the /SPE/DIRDLV checks (006, 014) run for a storage location that has no warehouse number? Is there a configuration or BAdI that causes them, and does it affect only the BAPI path and not VL02N?
  3. Is it possible to pass the desired batch at creation time, so that FIFO determination is skipped (for example by giving the batch split items directly in BAPI_OUTB_DELIVERY_CREATE_SLS)?

I can provide the exact BAPI input/return tables if needed. Thank you!

entry.title: RAP unmanaged BO: BAPI_OUTB_DELIVERY_CONFIRM_DEC dumps in saver – best approach?
entry.content:
Hello,

I'm building a Fiori Elements app (OData V4, RAP) that posts goods issue (PGI) for outbound deliveries, and I'd like advice on which approach is most appropriate.

Environment

  • SAP S/4HANA 2023 FPS03 on-premise (S4CORE 108 SP03), SAP_BASIS 7.58 SP03
  • Standard ABAP package (not ABAP Cloud)

Why I can't use a released RAP BO

  • I_OutboundDeliveryTP / R_OutboundDeliveryTP only offer CreateDlvFromSalesDocument and CreateDlvItemFromSalesDocument. There is no PGI action, header update is not enabled, and OverallGoodsMovementStatus / ActualGoodsMovementDate are read-only.
  • I_MaterialDocumentTP can create a material document, but it doesn't update the delivery status, document flow, or billing due index, so it doesn't replace delivery-based PGI.

So I use BAPI_OUTB_DELIVERY_CONFIRM_DEC with HEADER_CONTROL-POST_GI_FLG = 'X' in an unmanaged BO (read-only list of deliveries + one instance action postGoodsIssue, no own persistence, no draft).

Problem

My first version called the BAPI in the saver's save method. It works when PGI succeeds. When the BAPI hits a business error, it ends with BEHAVIOR_ILLEGAL_STATEMENT:

LSC_ZI_PGI_CR=>SAVE
  -> BAPI_OUTB_DELIVERY_CONFIRM_DEC  (SAPLV50I)
    -> FORM ROLLBACK_CHECK           (LV50IF01)
       >>>>> ROLLBACK WORK.

The BAPI executes ROLLBACK WORK itself on error, which is forbidden in the RAP save phase. The user only sees "ABAP Runtime error 'BEHAVIOR_ILLEGAL_STATEMENT'" and never the real error message.

Options I'm considering

A) sRFC in the action handler (current solution)

In the action handler (interaction phase) I call the BAPI with DESTINATION 'NONE', then BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT / BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK in the same RFC session, and then RFC_CONNECTION_CLOSE. The saver does nothing.

CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_OUTB_DELIVERY_CONFIRM_DEC'
  DESTINATION 'NONE'
  EXPORTING header_data = ls_header header_control = ls_control delivery = iv_vbeln
  TABLES    return = lt_return
  EXCEPTIONS system_failure = 1 MESSAGE lv_msg communication_failure = 2 MESSAGE lv_msg OTHERS = 3.
" no error -> BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT DESTINATION 'NONE', else BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK DESTINATION 'NONE'
  • Pros: no dump. Standard messages (e.g. M7 021 stock deficit, delivery locked, missing CO account assignment) are returned to the UI immediately.
  • Cons: PGI is committed outside the RAP LUW, so a later ROLLBACK ENTITIES or a failure elsewhere in the same request cannot undo it. I also can't lock the delivery in the RAP lock method, because the RFC session is a different lock owner and the BAPI would collide with it.

B) BAPI in the saver, accept dumps on error

Keep the BAPI in save so PGI is part of the RAP LUW and RAP commits it. To reduce dumps I added pre-checks in the action handler: lock (ENQUEUE_EVVBLKE), picking/GI status, storage location, MM period (MARV), and unrestricted stock (MARD/MCHB).

  • Pros: transactionally consistent with RAP.
  • Cons: any error the pre-checks don't anticipate still dumps. In my test, a delivery passed all pre-checks but failed because of a missing CO account assignment (OKB9), and it dumped. The BAPI has no test/simulation mode I could call in check_before_save.

C) bgPF

Register the PGI in save with cl_bgmc_process_factory and run it after the RAP commit using an uncontrolled operation (IF_BGMC_OP_SINGLE_TX_UNCONTR), since the BAPI needs to roll back on its own.

  • Pros: runs only if the RAP transaction commits.
  • Cons: asynchronous, so the user doesn't get the result or error immediately, and I'd need extra logging/status handling. I also found a hint that RAP should use controlled operations (set_operation), but a controlled operation would dump on the BAPI's ROLLBACK WORK again.

Questions

  1. For a legacy BAPI that executes ROLLBACK WORK internally, which approach is recommended or supported in RAP: A, B, C, or something else?
  2. Is a synchronous RFC (DESTINATION 'NONE') in the interaction phase of an unmanaged BO considered acceptable, or is it expected to be restricted by runtime checks in later releases?
  3. Is registering an uncontrolled bgPF operation from the RAP save phase allowed?
  4. Is there a released API or a newer RAP BO for outbound delivery PGI that I missed?

Thank you in advance!

entry.title: How to enable CDS CDC extraction on S/4HANA table VBFA with RUUID (RAW16) primary key?
entry.content:
Hi Community,

I am trying to build a custom CDS extraction view on table VBFA (Sales Document Flow) in SAP S/4HANA 2025 to replicate data via ODP / Change Data Capture (CDC) into an external analytical target ( BW/4HANA embedded in SAP S/4HANA).

Due to the S/4HANA table restructuring of VBFA, the physical primary key in DDIC is:

  • MANDT

  • RUUID (Data Type: RAW(16))

The legacy functional business keys (VBELV, POSNV, VBELN, POSNN, VBTYP_N) are now regular non-key columns.

Approaches Attempted & Errors

0. automatic change data capture annotation => Fail

1. Manual CDC Mapping on Business Keys When attempting to define @analytics.dataExtraction.delta.changeDataCapture.mapping using the business fields:

 
@Analytics.dataExtraction.delta.changeDataCapture.mapping: [{ 
   table: 'VBFA',
   role : #MAIN,
   tableElement: [ 'VBELV', 'VBELN', 'POSNV', 'POSNN', 'VBTYP_N' ],
   viewElement:  [ 'vbelv', 'vbeln', 'posnv', 'posnn', 'vbtyp_n' ]
}]

  • Result: Activation fails immediately with:

    • Error while reading CDC annotations: mapping field does not exist [Analytics]

    • Error while reading CDC annotations: No #MAIN table specified [Analytics](The compiler rejects them because they are not physical primary key fields in table VBFA).

2. Using RUUID as Key with Automatic CDC If I define ruuid as the sole view entity key and set delta.changeDataCapture.automatic: true:

 
define view entity ZBQR_CDS_VBFA as select from vbfa {
  key ruuid,
      vbelv,
      posnv,
      vbeln,
      posnn,
      vbtyp_n,
      ...
}

  • Result: While it can compile, RAW(16) creates severe compatibility issues during replication. The consumer/target does not accept raw binary fields as unique keys for the ADSO, and converting it via bintohex(ruuid) cannot be used as an underlying table key for CDC database triggers.

3. Using @analytics.dataExtraction.alternativeKey I tried specifying the functional fields via @analytics.dataExtraction.alternativeKey as documented for (ABAP 8.16) while retaining key ruuid:

 
@Analytics.dataExtraction: {
  enabled: true,
  alternativeKey: ['vbelv', 'posnv', 'vbeln', 'posnn', 'vbtyp_n'],
  delta.changeDataCapture: {
    automatic: true
  }
}
define view entity ZBQR_CDS_VBFA as select from vbfa {
  key ruuid,
      vbelv,
      posnv,
      vbeln,
      posnn,
      vbtyp_n,
      ...
}

  • Result: same error as (1).

 

Another fact:

For the same approaches with MATDOC table the CDS view works correctly with RODPS_REPL_TEST delta extraction using BINTOHEX conversion.
